Hornetsecurity Holding GmbH (3)(4) | First-lien loan (EUR 3,150 par, due 11/2029 ) | 11/15/2022 | E + 6.50 % | 9.82 % | 3,149 | $ 3,409 (EUR 3,125 ) | 0.4 %

rationale: FX02 flagged fair_value_currency value U_USD as not USD, but the raw investment schedule presents fair values in USD. The schedule header is Fair Value (6), representative rows show fair value with dollar presentation, foreign-par instruments show USD-leading fair values with local currency only in parentheses, and total investments is explicitly dollar-denominated. The defect is therefore in the rule's treatment of the U_USD unit label, not in the extracted fair value currency.
